text.p: Pioneer-Standard Electronics Inc said Tuesday it appointed Arthur Rhein -- who has served since 1993 as senior vice president -- president and chief operating officer of the company.
The company said in a release that James Bayman, Pioneer chairman and chief executive officer, held the title of president prior to Rhein's promotion.
Rhein was vice president of marketing with Harvey Electronics in 1983, when Pioneer acquired the company.

Pioneer-Standard said Rhein served three years as vice president of Pioneer's Northeast region, became senior vice president of marketing in 1986, an elected officer of the company in 1987 and a member of its board of directors in 1990.
